source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis, hourly)
grain: hourly (the finest the Open-Meteo historical archive serves)

rules.window: session_sheet: the official start (actualStart, else scheduledStart) to start + the race length (winner total time, else Bryce total time, else the sheet race format, else winner laps x best lap x 1.05, else 45 min). race_day: 09:00 to 18:00 local.
rules.aggregation: Instantaneous values (temperature, cloud, wind) average the hourly stamps from the hour at or before the start to the hour at or after the end; gust is the maximum; wind direction is the speed-weighted circular mean of the from-direction. Rain sums the hourly precipitation of the hours that overlap the window.
rules.sky: storm: a thunderstorm code (95-99) in the window; rain: 0.3 mm or more, or a moderate drizzle, rain or shower code (light drizzle, code 51, alone is not rain); overcast: mean cloud 80% or more; partly: 30% or more; clear: below 30%.
rules.wetDry: series_report: the official series condition report on the race session decides (wet; dry; damp, drying or mixed read as mixed). reanalysis: 0.5 mm or more in the window is wet, else dry; the model never says mixed.
rules.tiers: Reanalysis is modelled, never observed. An official series report decides wet or dry where one exists; then an observed call (nearest station reports and race reports, analysis/career-weather/data/observed_calls.json); else the reanalysis.

calibration.note: Wet-or-dry agreement of the reanalysis rule with the official series reports on the same races (wet, damp and drying count as not dry). allDryBaselineAgree is what calling every race dry would score. A modelled dry is weak evidence.
